summary: Smoke/regression after fresh env restore of recovery/vps-2026-10-01. Backend: /api/health=200, login OK for all 9 demo roles with /api/auth/me returning permissions+role_scope+resource_labels. Core list endpoints 200 for superadmin: /api/leads, /api/customers, /api/projects, /api/units, /api/deals, /api/finance/ar/aging, /api/build/summary, /api/notifications. Frontend: superadmin login -> Beranda Control Tower loads with KPI cards + Pembangunan rumah + Seluruh Divisi; sidebar navigation to Pipeline Lead, Customer & Kontrak, Master Proyek, Pembangunan, Keuangan AR, Admin Permissions all render with no console errors and no error-boundary text. Leads page Impor Excel: data-testid=lead-import-button present and dialog opens. Admin Permissions page renders. sales@sipro.co.id logs in, shows role-scoped menu (CRM + Proyek-read + Kas Bon/Pengajuan + Analitik, no PENGADAAN/finance management). site@sipro.co.id logs in, shows Proyek/Pengadaan/Material/RAB/Kas-Bon menus; Beranda shows site-engineer dashboard (Proyek/QC Hold/Punch/Terlambat KPIs). Environment restore is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Login response payload uses `access_token` (OAuth2-style) not `token` — previous tests that referenced body['token'] would miss it; test fixture updated. Document the field in README/openapi so new tests use access_token consistently.

/api/finance/ar/schedules (no deal_id) returns 404 'Jadwal AR tidak ditemukan untuk deal ini' — endpoint is deal-scoped by design; aging/deposits are the list-level entrypoints. OK but a 400 or a top-level listing would be more intuitive for monitoring.

/api/construction has no project-less list endpoint; all GETs require {project_id}. Fine for RBAC, but consider adding a lightweight /api/construction/summary for Beranda widgets so UI doesn't need per-project fan-out.
WA/Meta/Google-Ads credentials intentionally absent in preview — endpoints behind them should return 503/'not configured' rather than 500. Not re-verified this run.
